# Shiva Grand Residency

> A comfortable hotel in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Located at 54, Old Post Office Rd, Near Collector Office, Gopalapuram, Coimbatore — 5 minutes walk from Coimbatore Railway Station and 1 minute from the Collectorate. Rooms start at ₹1,500/night. Phone: 090477 57777.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the hotel, room categories, gallery, guest testimonials, and reservation inquiry form.
- [Rooms & Booking](/rooms): Browse room types (Standard Double ₹1,500, Deluxe AC ₹1,850, Premium Family ₹2,000) and submit a reservation request. No upfront payment required; free cancellation up to 24 hours.
- [Local Guide](/local-guide): Curated guide to Coimbatore attractions (Marudhamalai Temple, VOC Park & Zoo, Brookefields Mall, Perur Pateeswarar Temple), traveler tips, and proximity map.
- [Blog](/blog): Travel articles and guest stories about Coimbatore — local food, parks, railway station tips, and more.
- [Blog – 5 Authentic Eateries within 1km](/blog/detail): Detailed walkable food guide near the hotel (Sree Annapoorna, Haribhavanam, Valarmathi Mess, Bird on Tree, street food vendors).
- [Contact Us](/contact): Address, phone number, map, and contact form.
